newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Mudslide kills child as rainstorm blasts Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Mudslide kills child as rainstorm blasts Hong Kong.

text.p: Heavy rain plunged parts of mainland Hong Kong into chaos on Wednesday, killing a child in a mudslide. Floods disrupted traffic and schools and courts were forced to close.
A mudslide in Kwai Chung in the rural new Territories area ploughed into a wooden hut where a family of six was living. Firemen rescued five alive but a four-year-old boy died.
Some roads were blocked and cars damaged as mudslides brought trees skidding down slopes in the hilly territory prone to heavy summer rains and typhoon storms.
Firemen also rescued residents trapped by floodwater in the rural Sai Kong peninsula.
In the urban business district of Mongkok on the Kowloon Peninsula knee-deep floodwater sloshed through shopping streets bringing many vehicles to a halt and causing long traffic jams.
